llvm_capstone_revision.snapshot: git archive of 53325bba0d5c (capstone/, compiler-rt/lib/builtins) committed in a scratch repository on p13, plus the uncommitted files below copied in; the builds and runs used that tree
llvm_capstone_revision.branch_head_at_report: 74a7b08f4e9a: two later commits on ports/nested-lifetime-controls (SQLite and Wireshark controls) touch only capstone/bug-corpora/sqlite and capstone/bug-corpora/wireshark

configuration.platform: virtual profile (CAPSTONE_APPLICATION_PROFILE=virtual, musl mallocng, arena 64 MiB), QEMU -M virt-capstone, one hart (-smp 1), exact bounds (x-capstone-exact-bounds=true), 2 GiB, -snapshot; one ephemeral VM per boot through capstone/runtime/virtual/run-staged.py
configuration.guest_env: CAPSTONE_EXEC_DIAGNOSTICS=1 (the launcher writes its domain fault line to stderr)

builds.mruby: 4.0.0-rc2, commit 9d523e2f74f2e63ca02840937523de61398a617d, the port's patches; capstone/ports/mruby/app/build-mruby-domain.sh, MRBD_PIN=4.0.0-rc2, one virtual SDK copied per arm, JOBS=12 each, both in parallel (110 s each, 116 s with the SDK)
builds.gc_c_sha256_both_arms: 8ebc0b1d2fdbdfa5dea291201c04b14ff7e3cf71dba10bfa1a65ada3dfecaaa4 (0008 is applied in both trees, all of it under #ifdef MRB_CAPSTONE_SUBLET)
builds.mruby_images_equal_to: the 2026-10-11 security-table and same-answers images (release-differential/results/2026-10-11-virtual: 7b5872bc7141cbad stock, 321dc9b98691cc0a protected)
builds.controls_flags: capstone-cc -O1 -g -std=gnu99 -DPOOL_ALIGNMENT=16 -DMRB_NO_DIRECT_THREADING -DMRB_NO_BOXING (probe/build-capi.sh's), protected adds -DMRB_CAPSTONE_SUBLET -I capstone/runtime/include; linked with the arm's own libmruby.a and spawn-shell.o

inputs.host: p13 (80 cores); six boots in parallel, each its own VM and lock
